general.upload_drag_drop: Click or drag and drop files to upload
general.asset_url_mode_help: Chosen automatically based on your server setup. Leave it alone if pages load correctly.
general.asset_url_mode_detect_extension: File extensions work fine on this server.

general.asset_url_mode_detect_unavailable: Detection failed. The server did not respond, so the style could not be determined.
general.static_cache_description: Translations, routes, component definitions and extension bundles are pre-built as static files so the first screen loads fast. general.static_cache_failure_parent_not_writable: The target folder is not writable. Check the folder owner and permissions on the server.
general.static_cache_failure_write_failed: Writing files failed. Check available disk space.
general.static_cache_failure_lock_unavailable: Could not acquire the cache lock. Check the cache store.
general.static_cache_hint_disabled: Disabled by G7_STATIC_CACHE=false — no static files are built. Every screen is served through the API.
general.static_cache_hint_dev_mode: Static files are built only in production mode (APP_ENV=production). Every screen is currently served through the API.
general.static_cache_republish_confirm_body: The static files will be rebuilt as a new version. Every visitor will download the assets again.
general.static_cache_republish_confirm_warning: This may take a moment. The site keeps working in the meantime.
general.static_cache_republish_not_publishable: Static files are not built in this environment (not production, or disabled).
general.static_cache_republish_failed: Startup static files could not be rebuilt. See the failure reason below. The site keeps working normally.

mail.smtp_settings_desc: Configure SMTP server for email delivery.
mail.test_mail_desc: Send a test email to verify your settings.
mail.test_email_placeholder: Email address to receive test mail
mail.mailgun_settings_desc: Send emails through the Mailgun API.

upload.allowed_extensions_hint: Enter allowed file extensions separated by commas.
upload.image_settings_desc: Auto-resize and quality settings for uploaded images.
upload.image_quality_hint: Enter a value between 1-100. Higher values mean better quality.
upload.orphan_cleanup_desc: Clean up attachments left without an owner because a form was abandoned before saving.
upload.orphan_cleanup_enabled_hint: Off by default — the operator must turn it on. When on, files and records of orphan attachments past the retention period are deleted daily. Attachments currently in use, such as the site logo, are never deleted.
upload.orphan_retention_days_hint: Only orphan attachments older than this period are eligible for cleanup. Allow generous headroom for forms left open. (1 ~ 3650 days)

seo.meta_settings_desc: Configure meta tags for search engine optimization.
seo.meta_title_suffix_hint: Text appended to all page titles. (e.g., ' | Gnuboard7')
seo.meta_description_placeholder: Enter the default meta description for your site.
seo.meta_description_hint: Description shown in search results. Max 160 characters recommended.
seo.generator_settings_desc: Generator meta tag for CMS identification. W3Techs and similar market-share trackers use this to classify the site as GnuBoard7.
seo.generator_enabled_desc: When disabled, the meta tag is not emitted at all.
seo.generator_content_hint: Leave empty to auto-apply "GnuBoard7 {version}". Enter only "GnuBoard7" to hide the version.
seo.og_twitter_settings_desc: Default meta values used by Facebook, Slack, Twitter, etc. for link previews. Per-page values declared in layouts override these.
seo.og_default_site_name_hint: Defaults to the site name from General settings. Enter a value only to show a different name in share previews (og:site_name). Leave empty to follow the General settings site name.
seo.og_image_default_size_hint: Default values when thumbnail size is unknown. Facebook recommends 1200×630, minimum 200×200.
seo.og_image_default_desc: Site-wide fallback image used when a page has no share image of its own. Shown in link preview cards.
seo.twitter_default_card_hint: Use summary_large_image for large image cards, summary for compact ones.
seo.twitter_default_site_hint: The site's Twitter handle (e.g. @gnuboard). Output is omitted if empty.
seo.google_analytics_id_hint: GA4 Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX) or UA Tracking ID (UA-XXXXX-X)
seo.verification_settings_desc: Enter site verification codes for search engines.
seo.bot_settings_desc: Configure search bot detection and SEO page generation.
seo.bot_detection_enabled_desc: Detect search bots and serve SEO-optimized HTML.
seo.bot_detection_library_enabled_desc: When disabled, only the "Additional Bot Patterns" list below is used to detect bots.
seo.bot_library_notice_body: Automatically detects around 1,000 search engines, link-preview bots, and AI crawlers. Pasting links into Slack, KakaoTalk, Facebook, and similar services will instantly show the title, description, and image preview. Use the "Additional Bot Patterns" field below only when a bot is missing from the auto-detection list.
seo.bot_user_agents_hint: User-Agent substring (case-insensitive) — patterns to treat as bot on top of library defaults.
seo.cache_enabled_desc: Cache SEO pages to improve response time. Leave unset to follow the value in Advanced settings.
seo.cache_ttl_hint: Leave empty to follow the SEO cache TTL in Advanced settings. Enter a value to override it here — min 60s, max 86400s (24 hours)
seo.sitemap_enabled_desc: Automatically generate sitemap.xml for search engines.
seo.sitemap_cache_ttl_hint: Leave empty to follow the sitemap cache TTL in Advanced settings. Enter a value to override it here — min 3600s (1 hour), max 604800s (7 days)
seo.sitemap_update_success: Sitemap regeneration has started. It may take a while to finish.
seo.sitemap_urls_per_file_hint: When URLs exceed this number, the sitemap is split into multiple files and an index file is created — minimum 1000, maximum 50000 (search engine limit)
seo.sitemap_gzip_desc: Compresses split sitemap files to reduce transfer size. The index file is not compressed.
seo.sitemap_hreflang_enabled_desc: Adds hreflang alternate links pointing to each language version of a URL on multilingual sites. Turn off to omit the links and reduce sitemap size.

security.title: Security Settings
security.force_https_desc: Force all connections to use HTTPS.
security.allow_internal_outbound_urls_desc: Allows private IPs and localhost to be used for outbound calls such as external API integrations and scheduled URL calls. Turn this on only when you need to reach servers inside your own network. It lets the server send requests to your internal network, so it is off by default.
security.login_attempt_limit_desc: Lock account after certain number of failed login attempts.
security.login_lockout_time_full: Lockout Time After Exceeding Login Attempts (minutes)
security.app_key_desc: Manage the application key used for encryption.
security.app_key_warning: Changing the key may make previously encrypted data inaccessible.
security.password_min_length_hint: Applies to sign-up, password change and reset. Not applied to login (so existing users are never locked out of their own accounts).
security.require_password_special_char_label: Require at least one special character
security.require_password_special_char_hint: When enabled, newly set passwords must contain at least one special character.
security.two_factor_auth_label: Require a verification code at sign-in
security.two_factor_auth_hint: When enabled, one more verification step follows the password check. Codes are emailed by default; installing the authenticator app plugin also allows app codes.
security.two_factor_scope_hint: With administrators only, ordinary members keep signing in with just their password.
security.ip_throttle_floor_hint: The per-IP request limit is six times this value, with a guaranteed floor of 30 requests per minute.

ip_restriction.title: Access restriction
ip_restriction.desc: Only allow the admin area from the IP addresses you permit.
ip_restriction.proxy_warning: Forwarding headers such as X-Forwarded-For are arriving while no trusted proxy is configured. Every visitor then appears as the single proxy address and the IP restriction misbehaves — configure trusted proxies first.
ip_restriction.enabled_desc: When off, the lists and rules below are saved but not applied.
ip_restriction.ip_placeholder: Type an IP or CIDR and press Enter (e.g. 203.0.113.24, 10.0.0.0/8)
ip_restriction.admin_allowed_ips_hint: Applies to the admin screens, admin APIs (including extension admin screens) and admin login. Leave empty to not apply this item. A list that leaves out your current IP cannot be saved.
ip_restriction.rules_hint: Only the first matching rule from the top applies. A * in a pattern matches anything, including /.
ip_restriction.rules_callback_warning: Rules on paths outside the admin area can also cut off requests from external servers, such as payment approvals and deposit notifications. Known payment, webhook and identity verification callbacks are excluded automatically, but requests an extension receives on other paths may be blocked.
ip_restriction.emergency_hint: If you get locked out, disable it on the server: php artisan security:ip-restriction --disable

modal.pattern_hint: A leading / makes no difference. A * matches anything, including /.
modal.memo_placeholder: e.g. Member management from HQ network only
modal.ips_required: Please enter at least one allowed IP.
modal.apply_hint: Applied rules are stored only after you press Save at the bottom of the screen.

password_policy.title: Password policy
password_policy.desc: Rules that new passwords must follow, and limits on reusing old ones.
password_policy.char_types_label: Require at least 2 of letters, numbers and special characters
password_policy.char_types_hint: e.g. abcd1234 (letters + numbers) passes, abcdefgh (letters only) is rejected.
password_policy.block_identifier_label: Reject passwords that contain the email's local part (user ID)
password_policy.block_identifier_hint: Checked only when the part before @ is 3 characters or longer, case-insensitive.
password_policy.block_repeated_label: Reject passwords with the same character repeated in a row
password_policy.block_repeated_hint: e.g. with 4, passwords containing aaaa or 1111 are rejected. (3-6)
password_policy.block_sequential_label: Reject passwords containing sequences like 1234, abcd or qwer
password_policy.block_sequential_hint: Reversed sequences of digits, letters or keyboard rows (4321, dcba) are blocked too. (3-6)
password_policy.reuse_desc: Members cannot set a password they used recently.
password_policy.reuse_count: Recent passwords that cannot be reused
password_policy.reuse_count_hint: Includes the current password (1-10). Passwords set by an administrator on the member create/edit screen are not checked, and that member must change the password at the next login.

password_expiry.title: Password expiry
password_expiry.desc: Require members to change passwords older than the set period, with a notice before they expire.
password_expiry.enabled_desc: The period is counted from the day you turn this on. Turning it off and on again restarts the count from that day.
password_expiry.started_at_hint: Passwords set before this feature was turned on are treated as last changed on this date.
password_expiry.days_hint: 30-730 days. A password expires this long after it was last changed.
password_expiry.notice_days_hint: 1-30 days, shorter than the expiry period. One email and site notification is sent on that day.
password_expiry.scope_hint: The "Password expiry" setting on the role edit and member create/edit screens takes precedence over this.
password_expiry.scope_selected_hint: Applies only to roles and members set to "Apply" on the role edit and member create/edit screens.
password_expiry.action_force_hint: On the expiry date all of that member's logins are ended, and a new password must be set at the next login.
password_expiry.action_remind_hint: Members are asked to change at login; choosing "Change later" asks again after the set period. Login is not blocked.
password_expiry.remind_days_hint: 1-90 days. Members who chose "Change later" are asked again after this period.
password_expiry.batch_size_hint: Applies to advance notices and expiry processing separately. Members closest to expiry go first; the rest are handled in the next run. Enter 0 for no limit.
password_expiry.schedule_notice: The scheduler sends notice emails and site notifications every day at 05:15. Mail settings and the "Password expiry notice" / "Password expired" notifications must be on. Tell members about the password change cycle in your privacy policy in advance.
password_expiry.run_disabled_hint: Turn on password expiry and save to use "Run now".

confirm_desc.notice: Sends the notices once now without waiting for the scheduler.
confirm_desc.expire: Sends the expiry notification and, when "Must change to log in" is set, ends all of those members' logins.

run.expire_mode: Expiry notification + end logins (when "Must change to log in")
run.disabled_notice: Password expiry is off, so this cannot run. Turn it on and save first.
run.expire_warning: Members whose logins were ended must set a new password at their next login.
run.queue_hint: The run is queued and its result appears on this card when it finishes. You cannot run the same target again until its queued job finishes.

activity_log_retention.title: Activity log (access record) retention
activity_log_retention.desc: How long to keep the activity log — the record of admin and member access and actions. Records older than this are deleted automatically every day at 04:45.
activity_log_retention.days_hint: {{min}}–{{max}} days. It cannot be shorter than the legal minimum.
activity_log_retention.legal_notice: Legal minimum: access records 1 year (2 years with 50,000+ members or when processing unique identifiers or sensitive data) · Permission and role change records are kept at least 3 years regardless of this value.

moved_notice.body: Identity verification mail messages are now edited under Settings > Notifications, category "Identity Verification". The mail channel switch and delivery logs are managed there too.

basic.title: Basic Settings
basic.desc: Configure provider-level parameters. Activation and enforcement timing are managed under the Policies tab.
basic.default_provider_desc: Provider used when a purpose does not specify one.
basic.max_attempts_desc: Challenge is locked after this many consecutive failures. Re-send is required.

purposes.title: Purpose-specific Providers
purposes.desc: Assign a provider to each IDV purpose. Unassigned purposes use the default provider.

logs_link.title: Verification Logs
logs_link.desc: View challenge request, verification, and expiry history.

storage.title: File Storage
storage.s3_region_desc: Enter an AWS region code or the region value of your S3-compatible storage. (e.g. ap-northeast-2, or auto for Cloudflare R2)
storage.s3_endpoint_desc: API endpoint of S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, MinIO, etc.). Leave empty for AWS S3.
storage.s3_use_path_style_desc: Enable for storages that only support path-style addressing, such as MinIO.
storage.s3_url_desc: CDN or custom domain used to build public file URLs. Enter the API address in the Endpoint URL field instead.

public_asset.title: Public Asset Storage
public_asset.desc: Configure the disk for serving fully public assets (product, category, review, and editor images, layout background images, etc.) via direct URLs. When disabled, the existing streaming method is used. Only files uploaded after enabling this get direct URLs, and those addresses stay in the saved layout.
public_asset.s3_help: When selecting S3, the S3 URL (CDN domain) in the File Storage card above must be configured. Without it, streaming is used.

session.title: Session
session.redis_shared_notice: Uses Redis settings from cache when Redis is selected.

queue.title: Queue

queue.redis_shared_notice: Uses Redis settings from cache when Redis is selected.

log.title: Logging
log.level_desc: Only logs at or above this level will be recorded.
log.retention_desc: Log files older than the specified period will be automatically deleted.

websocket.title: WebSocket (Reverb)
websocket.desc: Configure WebSocket server for real-time communication.
websocket.enabled_desc: Enable real-time features via Laravel Reverb.
websocket.reverb_notice: Reverb server must be running when WebSocket is enabled.
websocket.verify_ssl_desc: Disable for self-signed certificates. Must be enabled in production.
websocket.server_endpoint_desc: Internal address used by the backend to deliver broadcast events to the Reverb server. The host/port above is for browser access, while this value is for backend → Reverb internal communication. Leave empty to use the same values as the client endpoint above.

search_engine.title: Search Engine
search_engine.desc: Configure the search engine driver for integrated and admin search.
search_engine.driver_desc: The built-in MySQL FULLTEXT (ngram) engine supports Korean search without additional configuration.
search_engine.plugin_notice: Additional drivers will appear when search engine plugins (Meilisearch, Elasticsearch, etc.) are installed.

drivers.test_before_save: Please test connection before using external services

advanced.cache_ttl_zero_hint: Set TTL to 0 for unlimited cache (never expires).
advanced.debug_mode_desc: Show detailed error messages. Disable in production.
advanced.sql_query_log_desc: Log executed SQL queries. Log file location: /storage/logs/query.log
advanced.outbound_proxy_desc: Every request this site sends out (payment approvals, core update checks, notifications) goes through this server. Use it when an external service restricts which IP addresses may connect. Leave empty to disable.
advanced.outbound_proxy_bypass_desc: Requests to these addresses go out directly instead of through the proxy. Adding internal addresses avoids unnecessary detours.
advanced.outbound_proxy_bypass_placeholder: Type an address and press Enter
advanced.pagination_desc: How far totals are counted on large lists, and the highest page number that can be requested directly. Beyond the cap the total is shown as "N+" and only the last-page jump is hidden — moving to the next page stays available.
advanced.pagination_result_cap_desc: Counts exactly up to this many rows. 0 always counts everything (lists may slow down on large data).
advanced.pagination_max_page_desc: Highest page number that can be requested directly via URL. 0 means no limit. Normal next-page navigation is unaffected.
advanced.core_update_desc: Configure GitHub authentication for core and extension (module/plugin/template) updates.
advanced.core_update_github_url_desc: GitHub repository URL to check for core updates. (Core only)
advanced.core_update_github_token_desc: Used for core and extension updates from private repositories. Fine-grained PAT permission: Contents (Read-only). Leave empty for public repositories.
advanced.geoip_section_desc: Automatically detects the timezone from the IP address of unauthenticated users. Requires a free MaxMind license key.
advanced.geoip_enabled_desc: Turning this on enables the license key input and periodic DB updates.
advanced.geoip_license_key_desc: Enter the license key issued from your free MaxMind account. Get one at https://www.maxmind.com/en/geolite2/signup.
advanced.geoip_auto_update_enabled_desc: Automatically re-downloads the MaxMind GeoLite2-City DB once a week (Wednesday 03:00).
advanced.trusted_proxy_desc: Lets the site recognize the real address and visitor IP when HTTPS is terminated in front of it (AWS ALB, CloudFront, Cloudflare, nginx). The value can only be changed through TRUSTED_PROXIES in .env.
advanced.trusted_proxy_client_ip: Address recognized as the visitor IP
advanced.trusted_proxy_same_ip_hint: These two values match while proxy headers are being received — every visitor is being recorded as the same person.

info.opcache_disabled: Disabled — pages load several times slower
info.opcache_disabled_warning: OPcache is disabled. In this state, every single page view re-parses all of your site's PHP code from scratch. On identical hardware this can make responses several times slower, and the gap widens as traffic grows. We strongly recommend setting opcache.enable=1 in php.ini and restarting your web server. After changing the setting, this screen may take up to an hour to reflect it; clearing the cache applies it immediately.
info.update_available_message: A new version is available. View the changelog and update via terminal.

info.update_guide_note: Maintenance mode is automatically enabled during updates and disabled after completion.
info.manual_update_desc: If PHP zip extension or unzip command is not available on your server, you can download the release ZIP from GitHub and update manually.
info.manual_update_step1: # 1. Download ZIP from GitHub releases page and extract on server
info.manual_update_step2: # 2. Run update with the extracted path

consent_provider.title: Consent provider
consent_provider.desc: Choose the extension that decides visitors' cookie and tracking consent. Other extensions and visitor analytics follow the provider chosen here.
consent_provider.label: Provider
consent_provider.ambiguous: More than one consent provider is installed. Until you choose one, every visitor's consent is treated as "unknown", so external scripts and analytics stop.
consent_provider.missing: The selected provider has been deactivated. Choose another provider.
consent_provider.none_no_provider: No consent management extension is installed. Visitor analytics are collected anonymously.

privacy.policy_notice_title: Update your privacy policy before turning these on
privacy.policy_notice_desc: The settings below irreversibly erase members’ personal data or change account status. The law requires advance notice, so document the retention and dormancy policy and announce it before enabling.

withdrawn.title: Erasing residual data of withdrawn members
withdrawn.desc: On withdrawal the original name and email are kept with a suffix so disputes can still be handled. Once the retention period passes, that residual data is actually erased.
withdrawn.enabled: Erase automatically after the retention period
withdrawn.enabled_desc: Off by default. When on, the nightly batch processes matching members.
withdrawn.days_hint: Members whose withdrawal is older than this are affected. Default 365 days.
withdrawn.irreversible_warning: Contact details, address, bio and identity-verification identifiers are erased and cannot be recovered. The name becomes a fixed placeholder and the email an unidentifiable form.

dormant.title: Dormant accounts
dormant.desc: Long-inactive members become dormant after an advance notice. When a dormant member signs in, that sign-in counts as identity confirmation and the account is restored immediately.
dormant.enabled_desc: Off by default. When on, an advance notice is sent first, then the transition follows.
dormant.days_hint: Counted from the last activity — sign-in or app/token use. Default 730 days.
dormant.notice_days_hint: How many days before the transition the notice goes out. It must be shorter than the dormancy period, and the transition only happens after this period has passed since the notice.
dormant.withdraw_enabled_desc: Off by default. When on, long-dormant accounts are withdrawn.
dormant.withdraw_days_hint: After this period a withdrawal notice is sent, and the account is withdrawn once the notice period has passed. Default 365 days.
dormant.withdraw_warning: A withdrawn account cannot be restored. Administrator accounts are excluded from automatic withdrawal.
dormant.restore_hint: Dormancy is lifted automatically when the member signs in — no application is required.

title.pre_notice: Members to receive the dormancy notice
title.convert: Members to be converted to dormant
title.withdraw_notice: Dormant members to receive the withdrawal notice

targets.hint: Counts and lists follow the saved settings. Even while a feature is off, they show what would be processed once it is turned on.

manual_run.section_desc: Run once now without waiting for the scheduler. It processes with the saved settings even when automatic runs are off.
manual_run.save_first_hint: You have unsaved changes. Manual runs use the saved settings, so save first.
manual_run.confirm_desc: Run once now without waiting for the scheduler. The job is queued and processed in order; the result appears on the card when it finishes.
manual_run.disabled_notice: Automatic runs are off. A manual run ignores the toggle and processes once with the saved retention period.
manual_run.skip_waiting_desc: Also processes members who were not notified, or whose notice period has not passed, as long as the period has elapsed. This skips the advance notice the law requires, so use it only under your own responsibility.
manual_run.irreversible: This cannot be undone. Check the count and the target list before running.
manual_run.queue_hint: A queue worker must be running. You cannot run the same target again until its queued job finishes.
manual_run.queued_toast: The run has been queued. The result will appear on the card when it finishes.
manual_run.preview_failed: Could not load the target count.

form.scope_help: Choose which kind of request enforces identity verification.
form.target_help: Depending on the trigger, enter the route name (e.g. api.auth.register) or the event name (e.g. core.auth.after_register).
form.purpose_help: Pick what kind of identity verification this policy requires.
form.grace_minutes_help: If the user verified within this window, do not ask again. Set to 0 to always require verification.
form.priority_desc: When multiple policies apply to the same location, a higher number is applied first. Saving is rejected if two policies share the same location and the same number, since the order of enforcement would be undefined.

alerts.consent_cookie_fallback: The consent plugin is active: visitors who accepted both analytics and functional cookies are recorded in IP mode, and all others anonymously (no IP, no visitor cookie).
alerts.queue_backlog: {{count}} jobs waiting in the queue — check that a worker is running.
alerts.queue_backlog_one: {{count}} job waiting in the queue — check that a worker is running.
alerts.geoip_off: GeoIP is off: countries are estimated from the browser language and regions/cities are not collected.
alerts.anonymous_mode: In anonymous mode the visitor key changes daily, so one person's visits are only grouped within a day.
alerts.unit_downgraded: Hourly aggregates are outside their retention window, so the series is shown per day.
alerts.load_failed: Could not load the statistics. Please try again in a moment.
alerts.site_timezone: Times on this screen follow the site timezone ({timezone}), which differs from the timezone set in your account.

referrers.urls_hint: The actual URLs visitors came from on this domain. Visits recorded while referrer URL anonymization was on kept only the domain, so they collapse into a single row.
referrers.urls_empty_description: No visits from this domain in the selected period.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Browser, OS, device, resolution, language and locale breakdown.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Visits by country, region and city. Regions and cities need GeoIP.

patterns.title: Weekday & hour
patterns.description: Average visit pattern by weekday and hour of day.
patterns.hourly_from: Hourly patterns are available from {{date}} — earlier hourly aggregates were pruned.
patterns.average_note: Values are averages over the same weekday/hour in the period, not sums.

actions.title: Search, downloads & goals
actions.description: Site search keywords, downloaded files, outbound links and goals recorded by extensions.
actions.dimensions_hint: Breakdowns provided by installed extensions (e.g. by board) split visits here. If an extension is turned off or removed with its data kept, it is marked "inactive extension" and its stats remain viewable.
actions.dimensions_empty_description: Choose a breakdown above to see its top list.
actions.dimensions_none_description: None of the active extensions provides a breakdown. When an extension declares one, you can choose it here.
actions.dimension_pii_title: Personal-data breakdowns are not turned into stats tables
actions.dimension_pii_description: The extension marked the values of this breakdown as personal data. To keep them out of the permanent daily stats, no table is built; the values stay only in visit records and are removed when the retention period ends or on a data subject deletion request.
actions.events_empty: No events yet. Names that extensions send with G7Core.analytics.trackEvent() appear here.

realtime.title: Realtime
realtime.description: Who is on the site right now and what they are viewing.
realtime.empty: No visitors in the recent window

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.description: Visit records grouped per person. Pick one to see the action timeline.
visitors.search_placeholder: Visitor key, IP or member ID (#123 for that member only) (Enter)

bots.title: Bots & crawlers
bots.description: How much search engines and crawlers fetch, and which URLs.
bots.recent_hint: Shows up to 50 of the most recent requests within the selected period.

diagnostics.declaration_warnings_description: Conversions or breakdowns an extension declared that were left out because they are malformed, with the reason. Pass this on to the extension developer.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Find out why numbers stop growing — collection, queue, archive and storage.

fields.worker_hint: Jobs are waiting — archiving and anonymization need a running worker (queue:work). Visit collection is recorded without one.

diagnostics.exclusion_note: Lives in cache — clears when the cache is flushed
diagnostics.queued_toast: Re-aggregation queued. Watch the progress in the run history.
diagnostics.skipped_toast: Skipped — another aggregation is already running.

privacy_requests.title: Data subject requests
privacy_requests.description: Find, export or delete the records of a person who filed an access or erasure request.
privacy_requests.anonymous_notice: For periods collected in anonymous mode only the last two days can be looked up by IP.
privacy_requests.prompt_description: Pick IP address, member ID or visitor key, enter a value and press Search to list that person's visits here. The period is optional.

settings.title: Analytics settings
settings.description: Collection, privacy, bots, retention and reports. Saving applies every value you changed, on any tab.

collection.enabled_hint: When off, beacons still get 204 but nothing is recorded.
collection.excluded_url_patterns_hint: Paths never counted, such as admin screens. The tracker filters with the same rules.
collection.site_search_hint: The search API hook records keywords and result counts.
collection.public_summary_hint: Enables the public summary API read by the home page counter.

opt_out.title: Don't count my visits
opt_out.hint: Excludes this browser from statistics — so your own visits don't top the page list while you work on the site.

full.title: Full
full.description: Recognises returning visitors with a cookie and stores masked IPs.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: Only visitors allowed by the consent plugin get a cookie and IP storage.
consent.traits: Returning ✅ (consented) · Cookie on consent · IP on consent

anonymous.title: Anonymous
anonymous.description: No cookie: visits are grouped by a daily hash and IPs are never stored.

privacy.respect_dnt_hint: Visitors sending the DNT signal are not counted.
privacy.ip_mask_hint: With no masking the city stays accurate, and at 1 octet the city usually survives. From 2 octets only the country is reliable; 3 octets makes even the country inaccurate.
privacy.geo_before_mask_hint: Uses the original IP for geolocation to keep accuracy.
privacy.pseudonymize_user_id_hint: Stores a hash instead of the member ID.

bots.bot_detector_enabled_hint: Shares the bot verdict of SEO settings. Even when off, the built-in classifier filters bots.
bots.bot_tracking_enabled_hint: Counts bot visits separately and shows them on the Bots screen.
bots.exclude_prefetch_hint: Requests prefetched by the browser are not real views.
bots.ip_allowlist_hint: These addresses are counted even if another exclusion rule matches.
bots.country_filter_geoip_hint: GeoIP must be on to use the country filter.

retention.retention_days_hint: When visit/action ledgers are pruned. Daily and monthly aggregates are kept forever.
retention.top_n_hint: Overview · dashboard · detail, in that order.
retention.storage_unsupported: This database driver does not report table sizes.
retention.storage_permission_required: Storage usage requires the analytics view permission.
retention.archive_on_view_enabled_hint: Re-archive stats older than a minute when a screen is opened or refreshed. Busy sites should register the scheduler (cron).
retention.archive_on_view_max_visits_hint: When today has more visits than this, screens do not archive on view.
retention.duration_bucket_bounds_hint: Comma-separated bounds in seconds (default 10,30,60,180,600,1800). Changes apply to later archives; recompute past periods with range re-archiving in diagnostics.
retention.pages_bucket_bounds_hint: Comma-separated page counts (default 1,2,3,4,5,7,10,14,20). Changes apply to later archives; recompute past periods with range re-archiving in diagnostics.

reports.weekly_hint: Sent to the admin role every Monday at 08:00.
reports.monthly_hint: Sent to the admin role on the 1st at 08:00.
reports.definitions_description: Whether report and alert notifications are active and their channels. Edit templates in Settings › Notification definitions.
reports.definition_inactive_alert: Report mail is on but its notification definition is off, so no mail will be sent — enable the definition below.
reports.definitions_permission_required: Notification definitions require the notification settings permission to view or change.
reports.reset_confirm: Reset this notification's templates to the defaults?

retro.title: Apply to existing data as well?
retro.body: IPs, referrer URLs and member IDs in the stored records (visits {{visits}} · actions {{actions}}) will be rewritten to the new setting. This cannot be undone.
retro.hint: Aggregates are untouched — they contain nothing that identifies a person.
retro.confirm_label: I understand this cannot be undone
retro.queued: Retroactive anonymization started. Watch the progress in the Diagnostics run history.

purge.title: Delete all analytics data
purge.body: Deletes visit/action ledgers, aggregates, bot logs, failure logs, run history and salts. This cannot be undone.
purge.confirm_label: I understand everything will be deleted and cannot be restored

reaggregate.title: Re-aggregate a range
reaggregate.hint: Days past the ledger retention are skipped (their aggregates stay). Several months can take minutes.

subject_delete.title: Delete data subject records
subject_delete.body: Actions and conversions of the matching visits are deleted first, then the visits. Aggregates stay. This cannot be undone.
subject_delete.confirm_label: I understand this cannot be undone

freshness.scheduled: Last archived {{time}} · archived automatically at 5 past every hour
freshness.on_view: Last archived {{time}} · re-archived at most once a minute when you open or refresh a screen

row_trend.open: Show the trend of this item
row_trend.title: Trend of {{label}}
row_trend.unit_downgraded: Per-item stats are daily, so this shows days instead of hours.
row_trend.error: Could not load the trend. Try opening it again shortly.
